title: Cancellation Refund Worksheet: Harbison 5-Year and 10-Year Labor Protection
content:
This worksheet defines the refund credited when the holder of a Harbison 5-Year Labor Protection or Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection contract — the labor-only tiers of Harbison Protection Contracts — confirms the cancellation request on file. The cancellation takes effect on the date of confirmation.

**1. Full refund.** A holder who gives notice within the tier's full-refund days of the purchase date, the day of notice being the day the pending written cancellation request was received or else the date of confirmation, with no claim payout made on the contract, is refunded the full contract price.

**2. Outside the full-refund case.**

- *Term's months* — the tier's labor coverage years times twelve.
- *Unused full months* — the complete month-to-month steps from the date the cancellation takes effect that end on or before the coverage end.
- *Unused value* — the contract price multiplied by the unused full months divided by the term's months, rounded to the cent, half up. A contract still pending counts its whole term as unused, so its unused value is the contract price.
- *Claims deducted* — every claim payout made on the contract.
- *Administrative fee charged* — the tier's cancellation administrative fee.
- *Refund* — the unused value less the claims deducted and less the administrative fee charged, never below zero, rounded to the cent, half up.

The tier's full-refund days, labor coverage years and cancellation administrative fee are the figures listed for the tier in the Harbison Protection Contracts schedules; the contract price, purchase date, coverage end and claim payouts are read from the contract and its histories.

**Worked figures (hypothetical contract; the $50.00 administrative fee is used for illustration).**

| Input | Value |
|---|---|
| tier | Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection, term's months 120 |
| contract price | $1000.00 |
| coverage end | 14 June 2031 |
| date of confirmation, the date the cancellation takes effect | 20 March 2026 |
| notice inside the full-refund days | no |
| claim payouts made | $200.00 |
| administrative fee | $50.00 |

- Unused full months: stepping month to month from 20 March 2026, the step ending 20 May 2031 is the last on or before 14 June 2031 — 62 months.
- Unused value: $1000.00 multiplied by 62 and divided by 120 is $516.666…, rounded to **$516.67**.
- Refund: $516.67 less $200.00 less $50.00 is **$266.67**.

Same contract with claim payouts of $600.00: $516.67 less $600.00 less $50.00 is below zero, so the refund is **$0.00**.

Same contract, notice given on day 20 after purchase and no claim payout ever made: the refund is the full contract price, **$1000.00**.
